deadline.value: PhD applications are due January 7 each year (year inferred).
deadline.quote: Applications are due by January 7th each year for the Doctorate in Statistics.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required for the PhD; scores may be submitted and are given equal consideration.
gre_general.quote: Applying students may submit a GRE score if they choose to do so, but applications without GRE scores are given full consideration, as are applications with GRE scores.

also.quote: Applications to the PhD program in Statistics do NOT require a GRE score.

funding.value: All PhD students in good standing receive year-round support (stipend, tuition, fees) and are guaranteed five years on admission.
funding.quote: On admission, Ph.D. students are guaranteed five years of support.

also.quote: All Statistics Ph.D. students in good standing receive year-round financial support in the form of assistantships and fellowships.

entry_route.value: You can apply directly to the PhD without a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Students hoping to earn a Ph.D. in statistics may apply directly to the Ph.D. program without need for a master's degree.
